newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce in engine pact with Marubeni.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce in engine pact with Marubeni.

text.p: Rolls-Royce Plc said on Tuesday it had signed a deal with Japan's Marubeni Corp under which Marubeni would become a risk- and revenue-sharing partner in Rolls' Trent aircraft engine programme.
Under the memorandum of understanding, the two companies will cooperate on a range of activities to enhance sales opportunities for the engines, especially in the Asia-Pacific.
Rolls-Royce said in a joint statement with Marubeni that the Trent had already captured nearly 50 percent of sales in the Asia-Pacific market.
It added that Marubeni joined eight other risk and revenue sharing partners already in the Trent programme.
The companies said the pact was built on their existing partnership, in which Marubeni has worked with Rolls-Royce in strategic planning.
